acceptance: Before urlsplit runs, validate_origin rejects any character matching str.isspace(), ASCII U+0000 through U+001F, U+007F or a literal backslash, anywhere in the supplied address.
The four malformed inputs in acceptance/proof.py raise ValueError: an embedded space, an embedded backslash, a trailing newline and a leading tab.

https://example.com, https://mac.example.ts.net and http://127.0.0.1:8790 return unchanged. http://localhost:8790/, http://[::1]:8790/ and https://Example.COM:443/ return their original spelling with the trailing slash removed.
All existing structural checks, remote HTTPS restrictions, port validation and error messages remain unchanged for inputs without the newly prohibited characters.
The candidate changes only src/agent_arena/control/configuration.py, and the existing frozen {python} acceptance/proof.py check passes.

src/agent_arena/control/configuration.py:8-23 already checks scheme, hostname, credentials, path, query, fragment, remote HTTPS and ports. Its return value preserves the supplied spelling while removing trailing slashes.
src/agent_arena/control/__main__.py:125-128 and src/agent_arena/control/api.py:52-61 use this shared validator for startup and allowed origins, so one localized change covers both entry points.
tests/control/test_control.py:433-496 exercises existing invalid-address rejection, secure remote pairing and service configuration preservation.

acceptance/proof.py:6-17 skips an unchanged configuration baseline and checks four malformed addresses once that file changes. The current baseline passed the proof despite accepting those addresses during direct execution.

tasks.instructions: In src/agent_arena/control/configuration.py, add a guard at the start of validate_origin, immediately before value = urlsplit(origin). Use any(...) over the original input to reject characters for which char.isspace() is true, ord(char) is below 32, ord(char) equals 127, or char is a literal backslash. Raise ValueError with the message 'Origin must not contain whitespace, control characters or backslashes'. Add a short comment explaining that this must precede parsing because urlsplit can discard some whitespace and control characters. Leave the existing parsing, structural validation, remote HTTPS restriction, port validation and return origin.rstrip('/') unchanged. This directly fixes the reproduced malformed-address acceptance and the changed-file contract in acceptance/proof.py. Preserve the integrated manifest metadata and use the existing frozen verification gate.
